usageHeader.name: X-Control-Require-Usage-Tokens-Return
usageHeader.meaning: Request terminal usage.text_words; multiple usage markers can be comma-separated.

resources.purpose: 声音复刻2.0; do not infer system-voice compatibility from ICL_ prefix

user.uid.description: User UID; historical page does not specify type/default/required.

req_params.text.description: Neither HTTP page specifies a numeric byte limit. Historical page requires at least text or ssml.

req_params.ssml.current: Chinese/English voices support SSML; requires additions.disable_markdown_filter=false.

req_params.model.historical: standard filters QA/CoT; expressive supports QA/CoT.

req_params.audio_params.format.note: WAV discouraged for streaming: repeated WAV headers. PCM recommended.

req_params.audio_params.sample_rate.historical: Historical v3 supports the seven rates without format distinction. Current page resource IDs scoped to 2.0.

req_params.audio_params.emotion.note: Only exact per-voice documented IDs. Global vocabulary does not establish universal compatibility.

req_params.audio_params.emotion_scale.note: Intensity nonlinear;3 and5 may sound similar.

req_params.audio_params.enable_timestamp.note: TN word timing at sentence-end before next sentence audio; small languages/dialects unsupported.

req_params.audio_params.enable_subtitle.note: Original-text word timings may follow next audio. Historical page: no subtitles with enable_latex_tn=true or nonempty SSML; small languages/dialects unsupported.

req_params.additions.note: All additions.* paths live inside this serialized string, not at req_params root.

req_params.additions.silence_duration.note: After entire input, not every sentence.

req_params.additions.enable_auto_languag.note: Detect from first sentence;explicit_language wins;all explicit_language options except pt/es-es;auto Portuguese selects pt-br,Spanish es-mx.

req_params.additions.enable_language_det.note: Do not assume identical semantics to newer enable_auto_language_recognition.

req_params.additions.disable_markdown_fi.note: true parses/removes Markdown;false preserves literal Markdown. Both official pages agree despite counterintuitive name.

req_params.additions.disable_emoji_filte.historical: true keeps Emoji, ideally with timestamps.

req_params.additions.mute_cut_remain_ms.note: MP3 cannot fully remove initial<100ms silence;WAV can.

req_params.additions.latex_parser.note: v2 improved LaTex reading, adds latency.

req_params.additions.max_length_to_filte.note: Maximum parenthesized character count eligible for filtering;0 disables;longer contents spoken.

req_params.additions.explicit_language.note: Respect per-voice language column. nl/no/uk/fi/da/cs/hu/el/ro/hi/es-es only TTS2.0 zh_xxx_xxxx_uranus_bigtts. Do not apply full list to all1.0 voices. zh-cn supports Chinese/English mix.

req_params.additions.context_language.note: Reference for Western text;unspecified uses English,id Indonesian,es Mexican Spanish,pt Brazilian Portuguese.

req_params.additions.explicit_dialect.historical: Only vv_uranus with dongbei/shaanxi/sichuan documented;current catalogue expands this.

req_params.additions.unsupported_char_ra.note: Reject if unsupported text proportion exceeds threshold;minimum not documented.

req_params.additions.cache_config.note: Same-text cached audio retained1hour;cached result has no timestamps.

req_params.additions.cache_config.use_ca.note: With text_type=1 enables cache;do not infer cache on when parent config absent.

req_params.additions.context_texts.appliesTo: TTS2.0 system voices;historical also ICL2.0 expressive
req_params.additions.context_texts.note: Speech direction for speed/emotion/volume/tone;only first entry effective;not billed.

req_params.additions.section_id.note: Associate serial requests/history;round count and expiry limits exist but values undocumented.

req_params.additions.use_tag_parser.appliesTo: ICL2.0 expressive only;not documented for system TTS2.0

req_params.additions.tone_fidelity.note: Replicate prompt style/timbre;same language only;no cross-language or bidirectional stream.

req_params.additions.pronunciation_dict..note: Original nonempty,no spaces,unique;greedy longest match;matched text ignores SSML.
req_params.additions.pronunciation_dict..typeConflict: Official card says object;official JSON example is string array.

req_params.mix_speaker.speakers.note: Equal weights for very different voices may fluctuate.

req_params.mix_speaker.speakers[].source.note: TTS1.0 catalogue voice or cloned S_/icl_ speaker;DiT_/saturn_ unsupported.

req_params.mix_speaker.speakers[].mix_fa.constraint: All factors sum to1;individual range undocumented.

response.parse: Decode each base64 data separately and append bytes;transport chunks are not JSON boundaries. Official historical demo iterates UTF8 lines then json.loads. Null data on subtitle/completion normal.0=in-progress payload,20000000=successful finish,others error. SSE has numeric event IDs+JSON data;no reconnect/resume.

errors.meaning: Text too long;numeric ceiling not specified.

errors.message: speaker permission denied: get resource id: access denied

response.conflict: Current response card calls all nonzero codes failure;historical v3 endpoint explicitly has successful terminal20000000. Preserve terminal success.

gaps: No numeric text/context_texts UTF8-byte maximum on HTTP pages. Do not borrow1024 from small-model v1 parameter page79823.
No authenticated synthesis run;verified means official documentation verified.
15 TTS1.0 voice rows have exact emotion IDs. TTS2.0 natural-language direction is distinct.
